notes: Refits from the frozen 0.2.0 observation dataset artifact. Expected blocking findings are intrinsic corpus characteristics reviewed in the wave-1 P2.3 review. dominant_single_scorer_park_team: whole eras have a single official scorer per park/team, so some scorer-park pairs are fully confounded by construction. no_connected_component_for_effect: each game carries exactly one source family, so no connected component can link source families. category_absent_in_train_present_in_test: game-hash holdout folds are not era-stratified, so categories confined to early eras (parks, scorers) can be absent from train while present in test.
